name: qdrant-advisor
description: Diagnose and troubleshoot Qdrant with current guidance fetched from the Qdrant skills registry.

interface.longDescription: Diagnose slow search, memory growth, indexing problems, scaling decisions, and search quality issues. Qdrant Advisor fetches relevant guidance live from skills.qdrant.tech, follows the matching skill branches, and grounds its recommendations in current Qdrant documentation. Requires an agent with web-fetch access.
defaultPrompt: Help diagnose slow searches in my Qdrant cluster.
Why is my Qdrant memory usage growing?
Help improve my Qdrant search relevance.
